profile.headline: Software Engineer at MIT Lincoln Labs

positions.title: Student Coordinator
positions.description: Managing after-hours operations for Rensselaer Union and Mueller Center to ensure building security. Oversee student staff members in the enforcement of union policies and completion of tasks by collaborating with other coordinators and supervisors to create more efficient procedures within the union. Resolve any issues regarding the facilities, staffing, or members of the campus community

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description: Worked within Aladdin Engineering, specifically within the Automated Order Routing (AOR) team. Helped standardize rules for trades as well as build and implement an aggregate limit workflow.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Linux · Network Engineering · BlackRock Aladdin · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description: Worked within the software applications team, helping to develop front end user applications alongside System Operators to improve robot fleet health and overall system by implementing new Control Center features.

positions.title: General Manager/Code Coach
positions.description: Worked as a general manager at the Syosset branch of the Coder School overseeing the coaches and students. Also took on being a coding coach, taking on students ranging from ages 7-13. Worked with them in languages such as Scratch, Python, and JavaScript teaching them basic/beginner coding concepts such as loops, functions, variables, etc.

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description:
-Was a sales representative for Cutco
-Sold kitchen cutlery (over $3,000 in sales)

projects.title: ELYRA (IBM) - Rensselaer Center for Open Source
projects.description:
Working on an IBM Open Source Software Project helping to fix issues such as proper documentation, front-end additions to jupyter-lab, and back-end issues working in docker and/or the Elyra pipeline
Using Docker, JupyterLab and Python as well as an understanding in Kubernetes
